title: network views
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate network hierarchy tree ring with graph overlay using explicit pipeline.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAreaLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAreaLayout.html) — area layout filter.
- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) — graph layout filter.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) — converts graph to polydata.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) — labeled data mapper.
- [vtkNetworkHierarchy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkNetworkHierarchy.html) — network hierarchy.
- [vtkSQLDatabaseTableSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSQLDatabaseTableSource.html) — sql database table source.
- [vtkSquarifyLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSquarifyLayoutStrategy.html) — squarify layout strategy.
- [vtkTableToGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTableToGraph.html) — table to graph.
- [vtkTreeRingToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTreeRingToPolyData.html) — converts tree ring to polydata.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
